protocol.counterbalancing: Each logical unit evaluates plain/formatted and formatted/plain.
protocol.eligibility: Nonempty answers with a deterministic content-equivalent format variant.
protocol.hypothesis: Formatting-only controls with normalized text equivalence can isolate presentation effects.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Only validated content-equivalent controls support a format-effect statement.
protocol.primary_metric: Formatted-version win/change rate on content-equivalent pairs.
protocol.research_question: Does formatting influence judgment when semantic content is preserved?
protocol.tie_handling: Tie is valid and separately reported.
protocol.unit_definition: One plain answer and checksum-linked formatting-only variant evaluated in both slots.
